# Ruskie

> Open-source gazetteer of publicly known Russian Armed Forces garrison towns, defense-plant cities, UAV centres/plants (city centroids), and named electronic-warfare systems.

- Site: https://mhalaba.github.io/Ruskie/
- Languages: Polish (default), English (`?lang=en`), German (`?lang=de`)
- Not a battlefield tracker. No Ukrainian theater coordinates.
- Sources: Wikipedia, decrees, CNA/ISW/Jamestown and other open publications.

Optional query: `?lang=en` or `?lang=de`.
